description: A detailed report of an individual's credit history.

fields.credit_score: The primary credit score mentioned in the report (e.g., FICO score). Integer.
fields.report_date: The date the credit report was generated. Format YYYY-MM-DD.
fields.borrower_name: The full name of the person whose credit is reported.
fields.total_debt: The total amount of debt listed, if summarized. Float/Currency.

description: A legal contract for the purchase of real estate property.

fields.purchase_price: The agreed upon price for the property. Float/Currency.
fields.property_address: The full address of the property being purchased.
fields.closing_date: The agreed upon closing date. Format YYYY-MM-DD.
fields.buyer_name: The full name(s) of the buyer(s).
fields.seller_name: The full name(s) of the seller(s).
